caption:
UWS Briefly · Aug 13–19

• Good Enough to Eat closes Aug. 30 after 45 years. There goes brunch on Columbus.
• Three men got into a fight at Central Park West and 71st on a Friday morning, and one of them fired a gun. At 8:45 a.m.
• Health inspectors closed the Subway at 2508 Broadway for the second time in six weeks.
• Jet's Pizza at 728 Amsterdam is gone. Another pizza place, closed.
• Wu's Dynasty, a Cantonese place from a founder of Wu's Wonton King, is coming to 208 W. 70th.
• A 200-bed women's shelter opened next to Gertrude Ederle Playground on W. 59th. Parents have complaints.
• LaGuardia High School dropped more than 160 spots, to 258th in the state, in U.S. News. Its scores and graduation rate didn't move.
• Good Company, a legal dispensary at 2273 Broadway, also wants you to read and do yoga there. Fine.

Links to every story are in our bio.
